fixture_description: Complete offline score-to-cinema project for an impossible city that remembers itself incorrectly.

project.title: An Incorrect Memory of the City

event_decisions.rationale: Defines the first visible permission to move.
Carries the film's single controlled mutation.

music_analysis_revisions.note: Human boundaries privilege dramatic recurrence over the broader measured sections.

music_readings.summary: A restrained system learns to breathe, mistakes recurrence for memory, and ends by withholding the expected release.
music_readings.emotional_arc: Latent permission becomes pressure, recurrence becomes unreliable, and the final cadence resolves through stillness rather than expansion.

sections.label: Latent permission
sections.structural_role: Establish a restrained field before the pulse becomes legible.
sections.narrative_possibility: A city exists but has not yet admitted that it is alive.

sections.label: First breath
sections.structural_role: Introduce a recurring expansion without literalizing every beat.
sections.narrative_possibility: One aperture opens and makes every surface slightly lighter.

sections.label: Remembered return
sections.structural_role: Repeat the gesture with delayed consequence.
sections.narrative_possibility: The city repeats the breath but changes scale instead of volume.

sections.label: Pressure chamber
sections.structural_role: Hold visual motion against the strongest energy accumulation.
sections.narrative_possibility: Stored weight deforms the city inward while the camera refuses spectacle.

sections.label: Incorrect recurrence
sections.structural_role: Permit one expressive deviation when the motif returns.
sections.narrative_possibility: The city remembers an opening that never existed and keeps it.

sections.label: Withheld release
sections.structural_role: Resolve by removing motion before the music fully disappears.
sections.narrative_possibility: Breath becomes architecture and the city cannot return to its first state.

significant_events.interpretation: A recurrence returns with the wrong visual law.

intentional_non_events.rationale: The energy peak is answered by near-stillness, not a cut or camera acceleration.

assumptions: The selected excerpt is treated as an autonomous dramatic unit.
No lyrical narrative is inferred because the source is instrumental.

director_treatments.title: Recursive Architecture
director_treatments.proposition: An impossible city learns to breathe by remembering each prior state incorrectly.
director_treatments.structural_strategy: Each recurrence revisits one composition while changing exactly one physical law.

narrative_path.description: The city discovers expansion and mistakes it for memory.
Pressure creates an impossible opening, then fixes the world in a new still state.

director_treatments.visual_world: Monolithic mineral rooms, oxidized apertures, and translucent membranes at an almost-human scale.
director_treatments.music_interpretation: Macro recurrences govern transformations; micro beats affect surface tension but rarely trigger cuts.
directorial_risks: The city could become generic science fiction.
Repeated architecture could read as visual stasis rather than memory.
director_treatments.rationale: The structure makes musical recurrence visible while preserving a strong autonomous cinematic ontology.

director_treatments.title: Submerged Organism
director_treatments.proposition: A single immense organism is inferred only through pressure changes inside a black reservoir.
director_treatments.structural_strategy: The camera never reveals the whole subject; musical sections change the evidence available to the viewer.

narrative_path.description: Small pressure wakes imply a body beyond the frame.
The reservoir clarifies while the organism withdraws, reversing expected revelation.

director_treatments.visual_world: Black water, suspended pale silt, membrane fragments, and no readable architecture.
director_treatments.music_interpretation: Energy changes visibility and pressure rather than object motion.
directorial_risks: The sparse imagery may become atmospheric without narrative progression.
director_treatments.rationale: This treatment makes the same score a withholding body film rather than an architectural memory film.

director_treatments.title: Negative Chronicle
director_treatments.proposition: Six forensic views document the disappearance of an event that may never have occurred.
director_treatments.structural_strategy: Every section removes one class of visual evidence while textless framing becomes increasingly precise.

narrative_path.description: Evidence accumulates but cannot agree on a cause.
The archive becomes exact only after the event has disappeared.

director_treatments.visual_world: Clinical stone tables, numbered voids without typography, fixed forensic lenses, and fading material residue.
director_treatments.music_interpretation: Repetition subtracts rather than returns; increased musical energy produces cleaner absence.
directorial_risks: Forensic restraint could become emotionally remote.
Implicit numbering must avoid on-screen text artifacts.
director_treatments.rationale: The treatment opposes the music's progressive accumulation with a rigorous visual subtraction.

film_bibles.theme: Memory is a physical law that changes the thing remembering.
film_bibles.world_ontology: The city is one continuous interior intelligence; rooms are organs and apertures are memories, never ordinary doors.
subjects: The city as a distributed subject
objects: One mineral plane at almost-human scale
light_rules: Light has one soft lateral source.
The amber accent may appear only inside the recurring aperture.
camera_rules: Camera behavior is limited to observe, approach, and drift.
No handheld motion, orbit, whip pan, or speed ramp.
transformation_rules: A recurrence changes only weight, scale, topology, or memory.
Transformations remain materially continuous and never become particle effects.
montage_rules: Cut on structural permission, not every beat.
Hold through the strongest energy event at least once.
invariants: The oval aperture recurs with stable proportions.
The city remains one continuous interior world.
No conventional protagonist enters the frame.

principles.rationale: Visible change arrives after musical permission and stops before full release.
The aperture binds recurrence without duplicating every rhythmic event.
The camera and composition become quieter as pressure rises.
A single visible fold mirrors the clearest spectral transition.

visual_states.name: State A — Latent City
visual_states.world_state: A sealed mineral chamber holds more volume than its exterior could contain.
visual_states.subject_state: The city is dormant and the recurring aperture is sealed.
visual_states.composition: Centered low mineral plane with an oval recess above the horizontal midpoint.
visual_states.material: Dry matte chalk mineral and unlit oxidized metal.
visual_states.light: Soft lateral grey light with no visible source.
visual_states.camera: Static observation at almost-human eye height.

visual_states.name: State B — Remembering Chamber
visual_states.world_state: The same chamber has gained depth by folding one wall inward without seams.
visual_states.subject_state: The aperture is open behind a taut translucent membrane and emits restrained amber light.
visual_states.composition: The recurring oval remains proportionally stable but moves one third right as space deepens.
visual_states.material: Chalk mineral under compression, oxidized rim, translucent membrane.
visual_states.light: Cold lateral light plus a narrow amber interior source.
visual_states.camera: Slow approach on a fixed axis.

visual_states.name: State C — Irreversible Stillness
visual_states.world_state: The folded chamber has become a weightless vertical plane while preserving its material continuity.
visual_states.subject_state: The aperture remains open but no longer emits light; its membrane is perfectly still.
visual_states.composition: Frontal symmetrical plane interrupted only by the stable oval aperture.
visual_states.material: Suspended chalk mineral, dark oxidized rim, clear inert membrane.
visual_states.light: Cold light flattens depth and removes the amber accent.
visual_states.camera: Static final observation with no settling motion.

music_evidence.description: Low-energy field before the first retained onset.

visual_score_segments.narrative_state: The city is present but has not admitted movement.
visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: Remain inside State A and withhold visible response.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Hold the sealed aperture through the first hints of pulse.

music_evidence.description: First retained onset permits the aperture to open.

visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: Move from sealed mineral to the first membrane tension of State B.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Let the aperture bind the recurring phrase while surface motion ignores minor beats.

music_evidence.description: The phrase returns but its consequence may be delayed.

visual_score_segments.narrative_state: The city repeats the breath and changes scale instead of volume.
visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: Deepen State B while slowing the camera below the musical acceleration.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Approach more slowly as energy grows; let the wall fold without a cut.

visual_score_segments.narrative_state: Stored weight deforms the chamber inward.
visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: One topology fold becomes legible while camera movement nearly stops.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Mirror the clear structural pressure with one continuous material fold, then hold.

music_evidence.description: Spectral change makes the recurrence feel incorrectly remembered.

visual_score_segments.narrative_state: The city remembers an opening that never existed.
visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: Accept a controlled weightless plane as a mutation toward State C.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Preserve aperture proportions while allowing gravity to fail once.

music_evidence.description: The expected visual release is intentionally withheld.

visual_score_segments.narrative_state: The new memory becomes permanent architecture.
visual_score_segments.visual_state_description: Arrive at State C early and remove all residual movement before the music ends.
visual_score_segments.transition_strategy: Complete the visual stop before the final musical decay.

shot_specs.musical_function: Establish the withheld response before the first retained onset.
shot_specs.narrative_function: Prove the city exists before it can breathe.
shot_specs.visual_function: Lock the aperture proportions, mineral material, and observation camera.
shot_specs.action: Only a nearly imperceptible change in membrane pressure is allowed after eight seconds.
shot_specs.transition: Hard cut at 9.5 seconds after the held field.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Animate the approved still with deterministic micro-scale hold and crossfade.
provider_strategy.motion_priority: Preserve stillness and material coherence over visible action.

acceptance_criteria: No camera motion is visible before the cut.

shot_specs.musical_function: Bind the first phrase to the aperture without beat-by-beat motion.
shot_specs.narrative_function: Give the city its first breath.
shot_specs.visual_function: Transition from State A to the membrane tension of State B.
shot_specs.camera: Slow axial approach beginning after the opening onset.
shot_specs.action: The mineral aperture opens as one continuous mass; a translucent membrane catches restrained amber light.
shot_specs.transition: Continue material motion through the outgoing cut.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Use a manually supplied state interpolation clip.
provider_strategy.motion_priority: One coherent opening action with stable geometry.

acceptance_criteria: Opening begins after 9.5 seconds in the master timeline.
No particles or mechanical door parts appear.

shot_specs.musical_function: Counter the accelerating recurrence with slower visual approach.
shot_specs.narrative_function: Show the city changing scale instead of repeating exactly.
shot_specs.visual_function: Deepen the chamber while retaining State B materials and aperture ratio.
shot_specs.action: The rear wall recedes beyond plausible depth while the aperture remains almost fixed in frame.
shot_specs.transition: Match the oval aperture across the next cut.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Use deterministic parallax from the approved State B image.
provider_strategy.motion_priority: Spatial contradiction matters more than surface animation.

acceptance_criteria: Camera movement decelerates as musical energy rises.
The aperture remains the stable motif.

shot_specs.musical_function: Mirror one structural pressure event while withholding camera excitement.
shot_specs.narrative_function: Make stored weight deform the city inward.
shot_specs.visual_function: Perform one continuous topology fold in the mineral wall.
shot_specs.camera: Almost static observation with less than one percent forward drift.
shot_specs.action: One wall folds inward without seams, debris, or material change, then holds under pressure.
shot_specs.transition: Cut only after the fold has fully settled.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Use a prepared practical fold plate and a static hold.

acceptance_criteria: The camera does not accelerate at the energy peak.

shot_specs.musical_function: Bind the altered recurrence to the same aperture motif.
shot_specs.narrative_function: Preserve one useful mistake as the city's new memory.
shot_specs.visual_function: Let gravity fail while all Film Bible materials and proportions remain stable.
shot_specs.camera: Lateral drift no faster than the prior axial approach.
shot_specs.action: The mineral plane becomes weightless and rotates toward vertical without breaking or shedding particles.
shot_specs.transition: Dissolve only the amber source; geometry remains continuous.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Use the approved Creative Mutation plate as the locked take.
provider_strategy.motion_priority: Preserve the expressive gravity failure without visual drift.

acceptance_criteria: Gravity failure is the only changed law.
Aperture proportions and mineral continuity remain locked.

shot_specs.musical_function: Suspend the expected release by stopping before the score decays.
shot_specs.visual_function: Arrive at State C, remove amber, and eliminate residual movement.
shot_specs.action: The membrane reaches perfect stillness and the amber source disappears; nothing replaces it.
shot_specs.transition: Hold the final frame through the end of the selected audio range.

provider_strategy.fallback_strategy: Use a deterministic still hold from the locked State C image.
provider_strategy.motion_priority: Absolute stillness and clean material detail.

acceptance_criteria: Visible motion ends before the audio range ends.
No fade to black and no new object appears.

evidence.finding: Visible camera drift begins 6.3 seconds before the score permits motion.
Material and aperture proportions remain consistent with State A.

review_reports.summary: The take is visually strong but violates the approved suspension by moving too early; repair timing only.

evidence.finding: The repaired take remains visually still through the approved suspension range.

review_reports.summary: Editorial repair resolves the timing failure without changing the successful visual layer.

evidence.finding: An unintended gravity failure strengthens the memory rule while preserving material and motif invariants.

review_reports.summary: The deviation is expressive, bounded, and eligible for a human Creative Mutation decision.

repair_plans.operation: Trim the early drift and extend the stable opening frame to preserve the 9.5-second suspension.
repair_plans.proposed_patch: Remove the first 0.5 seconds of generated motion, freeze the approved initial frame, then retain the final material state.
repair_plans.expected_effect: Motion begins only after musical permission without regenerating the successful image content.

decisions.reason: Only timing failed; regeneration would risk the successful visual layer.
The gravity failure strengthens the approved memory rule and does not violate locked materials, camera, or motif geometry.

operations.rationale: Remove early drift while preserving the successful visual layer.
Preserve stillness through the final musical decay.
